description: Docker host lanes: build and push the image, deploy the recorded digest over SSH with pinned host keys, compose healthcheck gating, digest rollback.

variables.name: STAGING_SSH_TARGET
variables.description: user@host of the staging Docker host.

variables.name: PROD_SSH_TARGET
variables.description: user@host of the production Docker host.

variables.name: DEPLOY_DIR
variables.description: Directory on each host that holds compose.yaml, .env and releases.log.

variables.name: STAGING_URL
variables.description: Base URL of the staging lane.

secrets.name: STAGING_SSH_KEY
secrets.description: Private SSH key of the staging deploy user.

secrets.name: STAGING_SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS
secrets.description: Pinned known_hosts line(s) for the staging host.

secrets.name: PROD_SSH_KEY
secrets.description: Private SSH key of the production deploy user.

secrets.name: PROD_SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS
secrets.description: Pinned known_hosts line(s) for the production host.

secrets.name: TS_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Tailscale OAuth client id, to reach the tailnet-only staging host from GitHub runners.

secrets.name: TS_OAUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: Tailscale OAuth client secret (pairs with TS_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID).

secrets.name: REGISTRY_USERNAME
secrets.description: Container registry user (deploy.registry is not ghcr.io).

secrets.name: REGISTRY_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Container registry token (deploy.registry is not ghcr.io).
